title: perf(mobile): home, workspace layout and overlay pieces compile with the React Compiler
body:
Home, the adaptive workspace layout and the overlay portal were skipped by the React Compiler. So was the thread list's action hook.

| File | Was skipped for | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `useThreadListActions` | six `try`/`finally` blocks around in-flight guards | the guarded body is an async function, cleanup in `.finally()` |
| `HomeScreen` | settled-list reset key kept in a ref read during render | state, adjusted during render |
| `WorkspaceConnectionTitle` | `useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current` | `useState` initializer |
| `AdaptiveWorkspaceLayout` | inspector render function written to a ref during render | written in a layout effect, which runs before the focus effect that reads it |
| `workspace-pane-divider` | latest-props ref read while building the pan gesture | gesture built once, callbacks through `useEffectEvent` |
| `workspace-inspector-pane` | assigning `.value` on a SharedValue prop | `.set()` |
| `OverlayPortal` | `??=` and a module counter in render | key allocated once in a `useState` initializer |
| `home-list-options` | manual memo deps | manual memo removed |

**Frozen-clock check.** Home read `new Date()` inside its list derivations, and the snooze-wake timer re-arms off their result. Without manual memo deps, the compiler would cache those derivations on their other inputs and freeze the clock. That is the same 50 ms loop fixed in [7f7d639](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/commit/7f7d6390d6ecfd7236db57ff8fdf6cd48ee01ab1). The clock is now state: the minute interval advances it, and so does the snooze-wake timer, so the next wake boundary always moves forward. A 70 s idle measurement on Home showed 18 commits total, no loop.

Manual `useMemo`/`useCallback`/`memo` are removed from every file listed. `KNOWN_BAILOUTS`: 66 → 58.

**Verified on device** (Pixel 9 API 36 emulator, isolated seeded server):
- Home renders, scrolls, and expands the Snoozed shelf.
- The filter menu drills into Environment (Menu + OverlayPortal).
- Rows open their thread.
- Idle for 70 s with no runaway commits.
- No red box, and no `useMemoCache` or React errors in the Metro log.
- Not verified: swipe and long-press on rows. `adb` input on this emulator registers both as taps on `main` as well, so I couldn't drive them. The swipe file (`thread-swipe-actions`) is not in this layer.

**Renders while loading each screen** (`measure-renders --route`, median of 3, same base and device):

| Route | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| `/` (Home) | 466 | 466 |
| `/settings` (over Home) | 1335 | 1335 |

No measurable change in the mount-and-settle window.

## Review follow-up

- Thread list actions (archive/settle/snooze/wake/regenerate title/move) await commands and clear their in-flight keys inline; no `.finally`.
- `wrappedRenderRef` is gone. Inspector registration reads the pane through `useEffectEvent`.
- On device: Home renders on the rebuilt client, and swipe actions weren't exercised.

Device: Pixel 9 API 36 emulator on nucbox-1, client rebuilt from `perf/mobile-compile-8` (the old one lacked the `T3FoldPosture` native view), Metro and an isolated seeded server on cups.
